description: Implementation of the RRC Resume Procedure handling in a 5G NR context, including security verification, message exchange, and context management.

classes.name: rrc_resume_procedure
classes.description: Handles the RRC resume process, including security verification, message exchange, and context updates.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine handling the resume procedure workflow, including security check, request notification, message sending, and response handling.

methods.name: handle_rrc_resume_failure
methods.description: Handles failure in RRC resume, including notifying metrics and releasing UE context.

methods.name: verify_and_update_security_context
methods.description: Verifies the security context of the resume request and updates security keys and SRBs.

methods.name: update_security_keys
methods.description: Performs horizontal key derivation to refresh security keys.

methods.name: reestablish_srbs
methods.description: Reestablishes Signaling Radio Bearers (SRBs) after successful resume.

methods.name: send_rrc_resume
methods.description: Sends an RRC Resume message to the UE.

methods.name: send_pending_dl_nas
methods.description: Sends pending downlink NAS messages after resume.
